verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service API platform. It could plausibly ship natural-language operation, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only REST APIs, webhooks, an llms.txt file and an OpenAPI spec. These are developer building blocks that an agent could use, not a first-party capability to operate the product with natural-language commands.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
